Terms of service

A little clarity. Better reels.

The essentials for using this website and requesting a service.

Updated 16 October 2026

Enquiries and confirmation

Browsing packages, downloading a draft or sending an enquiry does not confirm a booking. Availability, fees, shoot coverage, deliverables and any payment schedule must be agreed with the team before work begins. The website does not currently collect online payments.

Your content

Only share footage, photos, music and portfolio links that you have permission to provide. Arrange appropriate permission from people and venues involved in a shoot. Tell the team about restrictions on filming or sharing before the event.

Editing and delivery

Agree the reel length, style, music, delivery time and included revisions in your booking or editing brief. Delivery references on the website describe the offered service; the timing for your specific project is confirmed with the team. Additional changes or coverage may require a revised quote.

Portfolio and website images

Service-card stock photos illustrate event categories and are credited on the About page. They are not presented as work from client bookings. Ask the team to confirm any portfolio-use permission for your own footage as part of your project agreement.

Using the site

Do not send unlawful content, impersonate someone else, interfere with the website or submit another person’s private information without permission. Creator applications are reviewed and do not guarantee an assignment or income.

Questions and changes

Confirm any project-specific terms directly with the team. These website terms may change as the service develops; the terms and quote agreed for your booking remain the reference for that project.
